entry.name: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
entry.audience: Anyone demonstrating AI literacy on AWS

reading.cost: 100 USD. Visit Exam pricing for additional cost information, including foreign exchange rates.
covers: generative AI concepts and use cases
foundational knowledge of AI and ML on AWS
reading.format: The exam has 65 questions and is taken at a Pearson VUE testing center or as an online proctored exam. It is offered in Arabic, English, French (France), German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish (Latin America), Spanish (Spain), Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
reading.status: The AWS Certified AI Practitioner exam in Italian and German will be retired after October 15, 2026.
reading.summary: AWS Certified AI Practitioner is a certification that validates foundational knowledge of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI concepts and use cases for AWS services. It is described as a starting point for people exploring AI and ML on AWS, whether they are adding AI skills to an existing cloud career or beginning to work with AI and ML technologies. The credential is intended to show broad foundational knowledge of AI, ML, generative AI, and AWS AI services.
reading.audience: It is for individuals who want to validate foundational knowledge of AI and ML concepts and generative AI on AWS, including people exploring AI and ML on AWS in cloud, development, data, IT, AI and ML, or line-of-business roles. The ideal candidate is familiar with AI and ML technologies on AWS and uses, but does not necessarily build, AI and ML solutions on AWS.
reading.validity: This certification is valid for 3 years. Before it expires, you can recertify by passing the latest version of this exam, or by earning the AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate, which will automatically recertify this certification.
reading.prerequisites: The page says that if you are new to IT and AWS Cloud, you should first start with AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials. It also says certified individuals holding the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or an Associate-level AWS Certification do not need to take the foundational cloud courses and can start with free AI foundational training included in the Exam Prep Plans.
